sources.snippet: Overview Gemma4-12B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced is a 12-billion-parameter uncensored variant of Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 12B model, maintained by HauhauCS. The model achieves zero refusals (0/465 tested) while preserving the full capabilities of the original, built from official quantization-aware-trained (QAT) weights. sources.title: Gemma4 12B QAT Uncensored HauhauCS Balanced — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A community fine-tune of Google's Gemma 4 12B with quantization-aware training, built for local deployment via GGUF. The 'uncensored' and 'balanced' tuning means it applies fewer content restrictions than the base model while aiming to preserve general capability. It accepts both text and image inputs, making it multimodal at a locally-runnable scale.
